resolution.question: Will Prime Minister David Cameron appear in at least one televised set-piece event about the EU referendum before polling day?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if, before 23 June 2016 (polling day), the persistent event history shows that David Cameron appeared in at least one televised set-piece event (e.g., a debate, a major interview, or a televised town hall) about the EU referendum. Otherwise resolve NO at the close of polling day.
